parameters.name: Policy
parameters.description:
Policy content. JSON format, Key values:
- **policyMode**: Type of policy, default is requireAttestor.
- **requiredAttestors**: Required attestors.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the access source.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Set to enable or disable the policy. Values:

- **enabled**: Enable the protection policy.
- **disabled**: Disable the protection policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-binary-security-policy --source-ip 115.213.XX.XX --name test-policy-04-11 --remark Remark --policy PolicyMode_:_requireAttestor_,_RequiredAttestors_:_test-xcs-04-11-0000 --clusters Namespaces_:_default_,_ClusterId_:_c9f5b93a8da8f4341b7700000000000_,_Namespaces_:_default_,_ClusterId_:_cc12429dbb8f644f690b000000000000 --status enabled --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ModifyBinarySecurityPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --Policy 'PolicyMode_:_requireAttestor_,_RequiredAttestors_:_test-xcs-04-11-0000' --Status enabled --SourceIp '115.213.XX.XX' --Clusters 'Namespaces_:_default_,_ClusterId_:_c9f5b93a8da8f4341b7700000000000_,_Namespaces_:_default_,_ClusterId_:_cc12429dbb8f644f690b000000000000' --Name 'test-policy-04-11' --Remark Remark
